methodology: Exact current production CosmicFortuneEngine and CosmicFortuneRoundPolicy.Advance/SpendsLegacy; every paid cycle drains all earned carry and redeems every funded tomb ticket through SealedTombRules. One continuous state per selected stake, retained between nonoverlapping paid-spin blocks. The wager policy selects only legal new paid wagers; earned spins always use their actual locked funded wager. Strategies share only the within-stake reel/funding trace and use separate unbiased RNG streams for actual tomb outcomes. Main state retains the completed coins branch; tomb decisions do not affect reel rules or funding. Per-symbol contributions reconcile to settled reel returns and are diagnostic selected-match exposures, not an alternate payout model. Earned boosts are off by default; the explicit option spends only the actual saved special-point balance at the production activation cost on paid or earned spins. No live wallet/database/network access. Confidence intervals use actual paid-wager block ratios, not individual reel/action observations. Residual partial resources are reported and are not artificially paid out.

residualResources.note: Partial sigils, collections, energy and pity are carried through every block and left unvalued at the final boundary; no new paid spins were manufactured to complete them.

confidenceMethod.kind: continuous nonoverlapping paid-cycle block ratio means
confidenceMethod.note: Approximate Student-t interval from long blocks, retaining serial game state; a single smoke block has no meaningful confidence interval.
